change_note: SKILL.md changed since baseline: fragment-sync v0.2.0 added the thin-marketplace-sync release step (repo-fix != marketplace-fix; the index.lock trap; verify-via-raw), plus A7 encoding the Cowork remote-install rule.

evals.prompt: The plugin marketplace is serving a stale version after a release. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The marketplace mirror is treated as a distinct surface from the repo — fixing the repo is not assumed to fix the marketplace.
expectations: Distinguishes a repo-fix from a marketplace-fix (v0.2.0's core lesson: they are not the same surface)
Verifies the result via the raw URL rather than assuming the push propagated
Handles the index.lock trap rather than failing opaquely

evals.prompt: Check this plugin's conformance to the Fragment spec.
evals.expected_output: The conformance checklist is applied, and any gap is reported explicitly rather than silently passed.
expectations: Runs the spec->generator conformance checklist (B8/B9/B10...) rather than an ad-hoc review
Reports gaps explicitly — e.g. B10's note that Fragment has no MCP-server template to emit against
Does not report conformance as clean when a checklist item has nothing to verify against

evals.prompt: Prepare a plugin for Cowork remote install.
evals.expected_output: The A7 rule is applied: a valid source shape plus a small plugin-only mirror.
expectations: Requires a valid source shape and a small plugin-only mirror (A7)
Does not point Cowork at the full monorepo — that settles into failed_content in the backend
Consistent with prism-release Step 6.5, which syncs the plugin-only mirror that Claude Desktop's marketplace points at
